pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Cut.tsx:102 The cut draws a stored status rather than the measured offset, so a clip nudged off its mark still reads ok (lib/cut/deriveTimeline.ts emits only ok or missing), and the score cannot place a cue inside a scene or show a refused cue as anything but missing.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Cut.tsx:114 Signed ms readout and snap-to-mark exist, but the 50 ms step is coarser than one 40 ms frame at this cut's 25 fps (technique asks sub-frame), and status does not follow the offset: only drift->ok is derived, so a nudged ok clip never shows drift.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/CutClock.tsx:11 A cue's address is a first/last scene pair, so it cannot enter or exit mid-scene; the purpose field exists (Score.tsx:47) but no region can be marked as chosen silence.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Score.tsx:157 A refused cue and a never-rendered cue collapse into missing (CueView carries no refusal field); plate, card and motion refusals are drawn properly elsewhere (Cut.tsx:78, Strips.tsx, Motion.tsx:85).

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/CutClock.tsx:232 One clock, picture/voice/music lanes, blocks to scale from the sync offset (Cut.tsx:169), dashed missing blocks. Gap: no legend names the block states (rg legend finds only key legends).

pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureCut.ts:123 Sync status is only ever cleared by a zero offset and never raised by a non-zero one, so the finish line's drift row passes for a clip sitting hundreds of milliseconds off its mark.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureCut.ts:123 The offset is stored data and snap returns it to exact zero, but status follows a stored flag; no derived clip is ever marked drift.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureCut.ts:121 The block position and the bench's number come from the same stored offset.
